lines.text: This is where we record forever the Pokémon\nwho have performed so admirably for their\r\nTrainers, here at the Pokémon League.
This is the Hall of Fame!\c\nBeing honored here is one of the greatest joys\na Pokémon Trainer may achieve!
[VAR TRNAME(0000)]!\c\nYou’ve battled hard to become\na Pokémon League Champion.
Let us record this great achievement of you and\nyour Pokémon for all to remember!
